name: VEX IQ Drive Base
description: Starter VEX IQ (2nd generation) drive base: 2 IQ Smart Motors, one per side, driving 200 mm travel wheels directly (120 rpm at the wheel, about 0.4 m/s with no load), with the rear wheels geared to the front. Plastic beams and plates inside the VIQRC 11 x 20 x 15 in starting size. Motor numbers are VEX's published ratings (120 rpm, 0.414 N·m, 1.4 W); mass and size are typical values, not measurements of one robot.
